citations.quote: If identifier-1 references a bit data item other than an intrinsic function and the FILE phrase is specified
If identifier-1 references a bit data item other than a function and the FILE phrase is specified
If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it shall reference an alphanumeric, or national function

cases.reason: The words differ only in 'an intrinsic function' (2002) versus 'a function' (2023). No program can show it: in 2002 SR4 already confines any function-identifier (intrinsic or user-defined) to an alphanumeric or national function, so a bit identifier-1 is never a function. Format and the rest of the clause are the same (2023 only adds the BEFORE+AFTER choice in format 1). The pinned tree refuses the whole FILE phrase at every edition (COBOL1706, documented non-support of Annex A.4.13; PB5579 commit 388f468caa is not an ancestor of 24372b7b17). Main implements it (DEVLOG 3676); the evidence here is from the main-lineage build ebca604b6f frozen at E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/op-20261114/read-2002/out/probes-u-30/main-ebca604b6f (one merge behind main 63ab0c4ece, no src difference). EC-I-O-INVALID-KEY declarative without a FILE phrase (2002 also has that format, 14.8.45.3 GR3e). So for an unsuccessful WRITE (22) with only an exception-name declarative, the 2002 text conflicts with itself (9.1.13 item 4 vs 9.1.12's pointer to the USE rules) where 2023 is explicit. This is the same deferral the reader used to call GR10 DIFFERENT. The compiler at 2002 runs the declarative (r03: DECL-EC EC-I-O-INVALID-KEY, W2=22, identical at 2023), i.e. it takes the USE-rule reading. Also the row's only witness (pb1190_varying_advancing_bounds, a 44) shows neither 'record area unaffected' nor any transfer of control; the reader's coverage of those came from its own probe p02. Needs: an adjudication of 2002 9.1.13 item 4 vs 9.1.12/14.8.45.3 GR3e for an exception-name declarative, and r03 + p02 as 2002 witnesses.

The reader's ground ('every 2002 function definition states its argument by class or category') is false: 2002 MAX (and MIN, ORD-MAX, ORD-MIN) restrict only boolean/object/pointer and require one class, and their type tables map a National argument to a National function. Under 2002 AR8 a PIC 99 USAGE NATIONAL item (class numeric, usage national) IS a National argument, so 2002 admits reading MAX(N1 N2) as a national function; under 2023 AR9 it is not National and MAX is Integer. The pinned compiler takes the 2023 reading at 2002: STRING FUNCTION MAX(N1 N2) ... INTO a PIC N item is refused (COBOL1626, 'numeric, integer or index function') at 2002 as at 2023 (r02). The row's evidence (national_intrinsics, pb79, national-of-wrong-category) has no numeric usage national item as a National argument. Needs: adjudication of the 2002 MAX/MIN type for arguments that meet both 15.2 item 8 and item 5/9, then a 2002 witness (r01/r02).
